steps.what: Capture the actual specimen, method, procedure version, setup, calibration and observations from the performed test
inputs: actual test files and specialist observations
outputs: checked actual test details and source-file references

steps.what: Prepare the method, process and result report fields and attach actual test figures
inputs: checked actual test details and source-file references

steps.what: Write the test interpretation, limitations and any method deviations from actual evidence
inputs: checked actual test details and source-file references
outputs: complete test report with interpretation and limitations

steps.what: Verify the complete report against the test evidence and authenticate the final method, process and result documentation
inputs: complete test report with interpretation and limitations
actual test files and specialist observations

steps.what: Save the authenticated report in the same report document store
outputs: saved method, process and result documentation

tasks.design: Configure the native report exporter in test software {OTHER} to fill actual test fields and figures in {DOCS}. The specialist captures missing actual details, writes the interpretation and authenticates the complete report before saving it; no model interprets indications or signs a test result.
tasks.previous_blocker: Test details and figures are repeatedly transferred into report layouts.
tasks.enabler_now: Native report templates can reuse actual test files and entered metadata.
tasks.still_hard: A complete-looking report may omit a limitation that matters to interpretation.
tasks.human_edge: Distinguish an actual result from an artefact or unsupported conclusion.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: test software can populate report templates from actual data, while result interpretation and report authentication remain specialist work.

assumptions: OTHER is test acquisition and reporting software. Boundary is documenting methods, processes and results, including actual metadata capture, report preparation, interpretation, authentication and save. Report sending and asset release are not performed.

Test software supplies actual measurement files; the specialist supplies specimen ID, method and procedure version, setup, calibration reference and deviations in s1. Missing metadata is manually captured and checked there; no plan is treated as proof that a test happened.
Native report export first. Shares are unmeasured scenarios. Existing acquisition runtime earns no labour saving; only repeated report assembly changes.
Gross 24 minus 1 upkeep yields 23 net. Report authentication is existing technical correctness work after the final content exists; the same-store save is 1% fully retained.
unknowns: Current native exporter coverage and manual figure-transfer effort
research_questions: Can native export reduce assembly while preserving specimen identity, method deviations and all relevant figures?

already_counted.description: Review assembled report fields and authenticate complete report

incremental.description: Maintain report mappings and check template changes

approvals.approved_version: authenticated complete report from s4; any edit voids authentication

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero if native exports already do the work; up to 17% where missing metadata and report correction reduce central 23% net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Supervise non-destructive testing staff and trainees

steps.what: Consult the applicable test procedure and trainee authorization before directing the work
Supervise or direct the actual work of non-destructive testing trainees or staff and correct unsafe or unsuitable practice
outputs: supervised test work and immediate corrections

tasks.design: Keep the existing native procedure and authorization views in {DOCS} and {LMS}. The specialist continues direct observation and correction; no distinct supervision record or credential update is established by this task.
tasks.previous_blocker: A trainee may depart from the procedure in a way visible only during work.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing reference access supports supervision without replacing it.
tasks.still_hard: Judge when intervention is needed before a result becomes unreliable.
tasks.human_edge: Demonstrate technique and respond to the person's actual work.

ambition.what: No increase in supervision span claimed.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: technical supervision requires observation and correction of actual work, beyond access to procedures.

assumptions: Boundary includes actual procedure lookup and direct supervision. The statement establishes no separate report, completion entry or credential change; none is assigned invented time.
Quality owner supplies current procedure and training owner supplies existing authorization. Missing authorization requires manual confirmation within the retained work.
Native views are already sufficient in this scenario; no lookup reduction is claimed. Shares are illustrative and no change means zero upkeep.
unknowns: Whether local supervision requires a separate written assessment
research_questions: Observe any actual assessment write and separate it from live supervision if present.

incremental.description: No new tool or recording process

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Explicit procedure lookup and actual supervision both remain fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop and use new non-destructive testing methods

steps.what: Define the inspection question and develop a candidate acoustic emission, leak, thermal or infrared testing approach
inputs: known method capabilities and specimen constraints
outputs: specialist-selected candidate method and trial plan

steps.what: Set up and use the candidate method on actual trial specimens and observe the response
inputs: specialist-selected candidate method and trial plan
outputs: actual trial measurements and observed limitations

steps.what: Prepare comparative views of actual trial responses and inspect repeatability and detection limitations
inputs: actual trial measurements and observed limitations

steps.what: Judge whether the method is suitable and refine its limits or identify further trials needed
inputs: actual trial measurements and observed limitations
outputs: specialist's method assessment and next trial decisions

tasks.design: Configure reusable comparison layouts in test-analysis software {OTHER} for the specialist's actual trial data. The specialist develops the approach, performs trials and judges suitability; formal method documentation in {DOCS} is handled by the separate documentation task.
tasks.previous_blocker: Comparing trial responses can require repeated view setup.
tasks.enabler_now: Native analysis layouts can reuse channel and specimen views.
tasks.still_hard: A method that works on trial specimens may miss relevant defects in actual use.
tasks.human_edge: Challenge detection limits and recognize when more evidence is needed.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native test-analysis views can assist trial comparison but cannot establish a new method's fitness without specialist validation.

assumptions: OTHER is test acquisition and analysis software. Boundary includes method development, actual trial use and assessment; it does not certify a method or release an inspected asset.

Specialist supplies trial plan in s1 and actual trial evidence in s2. Test files retain specimen ID, method settings, channel and time; missing identity stops comparison pending manual resolution in s3.
Native layouts first. Shares are provisional; s3 reduction applies only to repeated human view setup, not sensor runtime or substantive interpretation.
Gross 2.5 minus 0.5 upkeep leaves 2 net. Formal method/process/result report authoring is separately modeled and must not be counted twice.
unknowns: Actual repeated layout setup and current native analysis tools
research_questions: Can native comparison layouts save setup effort while keeping specimen differences and limitations visible?

already_counted.description: Check trial comparison setup and sources

incremental.description: Maintain trial comparison layouts after equipment changes

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero where layouts are already reusable; up to 1% for smaller setup gains than central 2% net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Specialists retain test interpretation, supervision and method validation; native exports and views assist documentation and comparison.
skills_to_grow: Separate method evidence from planned settings
role.ambitious_version: Traceable reports and trial comparisons while technical authority stays with qualified specialists.
